messages:
sarah: Heads-up — planning to onboard aegis-4b (int8-q4) into the catalog tomorrow 2026-04-15 10:00 UTC. Need someone to run the deploy, someone for smoke + perf, and a rollback owner. Requesting catalog-slot-12.
min: I can take the deploy. I'll be available 09:45-11:00 UTC and can handle the deploy window.
kevin: I'll own smoke + quick regressions. Will run the small gen tests and latency profile.
sarah: Awesome. @min please follow deploy checklist and trigger KV warmup after loaders. @kevin I'll paste the smoke checklist below. @tara can you be rollback owner?
tara: I can. I'll monitor logs + metrics. If latency increases >5% or regression alerts fire, I'll unpin and escalate.
kevin: Smoke checklist (quick):
```
- deploy to staging slot
- run short generation probe (3 prompts)
- run 1k-sample latency/throughput bench
- run regression eval on critical prompt set
- sanity-check embeddings similarity on a small sample
```
min: Deploy command I'll run: 
```
./tools/deploy_catalog --model aegis-4b --version v1.2-q4 --slot catalog-slot-12 --pin --env staging
```
min: After deploy I'll run KV warmup: `python infra/scripts/kv_warmup.py --model aegis-4b --prefixes 100`
kevin: Quick smoke curl I'll run once the slot is up:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"aegis-4b","input":"Hello world","max_tokens":8}'
```
tara: Rollback flow if needed:
```
# unpin new version, pin previous
catalogctl unpin aegis-4b --version v1.2-q4
catalogctl pin aegis-4b --version v1.1
# notify infra + open a rollback incident ticket
```
ops-bot: Slot catalog-slot-12 reserved for aegis-4b 2026-04-15T10:00:00Z - 2026-04-15T10:30:00Z (reserved by sarah).
sarah: Thanks all — I've added the runbook and QA prompts to PR #4523. Please ping here when you start and when smoke completes.
kevin: Will post results. If everything looks good, I'll confirm and we can leave pin in place. :thumbsup: 
min: Starting deploy at 10:05 UTC, will tag @tara on any rollback action.
kevin: Smoke done at ~10:09, latency looks stable, small regressed prompt flagged (1 case) — investigating but not blocking.
tara: I looked at logs, no OOMs, memory stable. If kevin wants to keep pinned, I can standby for 30m to monitor.
sarah: Sounds good. Thanks team — marking this thread resolved after 11:00 UTC unless we see issues.
